task: Investigate whether Naukri's homepage health_check should remain a hard gate before search(), and implement a minimal fix if evidence-justified

current_flow_before_change.health_check_frequency: once per source per discover_from_sources() call, never per query
current_flow_before_change.health_check_side_effects: none beyond its own HTTP request

key_finding: This project has never demonstrated a run where health_check() failed AND search() was also attempted to observe whether it would have succeeded. Every prior success had both succeed together; every recent failure was homepage-only and pre-emptively skipped every query. No evidence exists either way that a homepage block predicts a search-page block for Naukri.

C_search_shaped_health_check.correctness: answers availability but duplicates search() and consumes effort for no extra benefit over B

E_health_check_diagnostics_only_never_ga.note: B chosen as the smaller, opt-in, per-adapter version of the same idea

recommended_architecture: Option B: per-adapter opt-in flag (health_check_is_advisory), default False for every adapter, set True only on NaukriAdapter with documented evidence-based justification. discover_from_sources() respects the flag: health_check() still runs and is recorded for diagnostics, but a failure no longer skips the query loop when the adapter opts in.

code_changes.change: Added JobSourceAdapter.health_check_is_advisory = False (class attribute, documented). No other change.

discover_from_sources(): gating condition now checks getattr(adapter, 'health_check_is_advisory', False); when True and health failed, state.blocked is NOT set and the query loop proceeds normally. state.health is still populated either way. Docstring updated.
Added NaukriAdapter.health_check_is_advisory = True with a docstring citing this report's evidence. health_check() and search() themselves are unchanged.

remaining_unknowns: Whether the Naukri search URL is reachable when the homepage is blocked -- unverified, no live request made this task
Whether ?jobAge=3 is honored by Naukri -- still unverified
Whether cumulative session/IP-level rate-limiting explains the recent homepage blocks -- unconfirmed
